title: Cartier pullback of the normalized relative Kummer boundary
statement: Let N>0 be invertible on T, A a finite commutative ring killed by N, and i:D→T an effective Cartier closed immersion. Let v:T′→T be any map whose scheme-theoretic pullback i′:D′→T′ remains an effective Cartier divisor, with closed comparison w:D′→D. Let κ and κ′ satisfy SupportedKummerBoundary over T and T′ respectively [def-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer-boundary]. Let t be any roots- and pure-tensor-normalized OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows]. Then Ext.mk₀ of the canonical constant exchange followed by κ′ equals the exact inverse-image image of κ followed by Ext.mk₀ of t.line. No flatness of v is assumed.

proof.text: The canonical Cartier pullback comparison identifies the dual ideal and canonical section with the dual pulled-back ideal and its section, including the complementary trivializations. The relative torsor class therefore pulls back to the primed relative class.

Kummer connecting morphisms commute with pullback of roots and units, giving equality of the abelian relative Kummer classes. The canonical module-to-abelian cohomology comparisons commute with inverse image and derived direct image on the scheme and its complementary open; hence they identify the module relative classes under pullback as well.

Supported-Hom naturality transports this equality to Ext with the canonical closed exchange. Roots normalization determines the root comparison, and pure-tensor normalization determines its scalar-extended line comparison; it is exactly t.line. Exact inverse image and its monoidal and constant comparisons commute with scalar extension, giving the stated equation for arbitrary finite A. When N=1 all coefficient sheaves vanish, and the same equation holds.

lean.statement:
theorem supported_kummer_boundary_pullback (T : Scheme.{u}) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    (hT : IsUnit (N : Γ(T, ⊤))) {D : Scheme.{u}} (i : D ⟶ T)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (hI : i.ker.IsInvertible)
    (κ : Ext ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) i).obj (ordinaryFiniteConstant A D))
      (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine T N A hA) 2)
    (hκ : SupportedKummerBoundary A N hA i hI hT κ)
    (t : OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A N hA)
    {D' T' : Scheme.{u}} (i' : D' ⟶ T') [IsClosedImmersion i']
    (v : T' ⟶ T) (w : D' ⟶ D) (sq : IsPullback w i' i v)
    (hI' : i'.ker.IsInvertible)
    (κ' : Ext ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) i').obj (ordinaryFiniteConstant A D'))
      (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine T' N A hA) 2)
    (hκ' : SupportedKummerBoundary A N hA i' hI'
      (by simpa using hT.map v.appTop.hom) κ') :
    (Ext.mk₀ (supportedConstantExchange A i i' v w sq.toCommSq)).comp κ' (zero_add 2) =
        (κ.mapExactFunctor (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v)).comp
          (Ext.mk₀ (t.line v hT).hom) (add_zero 2)
